This all sounds sensible to me. I can't speak to the technical choices in any depth, but what matters to me is that the plan carries through everything we settled on, and reading it that way I'm reassured:

- Automatic title/description/icon/preview capture that still lets me save when a page won't load — there.
- Read Later, archiving with restore, and permanent delete kept separate — there.
- Tags as the main organizer with optional collections, tag suggestions, formatted notes — there.
- The search that handles `#tag`, exact quoted phrases, and and/or/not — and I especially like that if I quote a word like "AND" it's treated as plain text and not as a command. That's the behavior I wanted.
- Selecting many at once (including everything matching a search) with a clear count before anything happens, and a confirmation before permanent deletes — there.
- My own library staying private, and everything surviving after I sign out and back in — there.

Browser import/export and saving a copy of a page staying out of this first version is fine, as we agreed.

The plan looks good to me — please go ahead and generate the implementation tasks.
